quarterly_data.signal: Accelink's 12.8T XPO DR liquid-cooled pluggable optical module (on display at its ECOC 2026 booth #1007) adopts the LRO linear receive architecture with a 64x200G PAM4 design: a single module delivers 12.8T bps, equivalent to eight 1.6T modules, in a pluggable package only 2.7 times the width of a traditional OSFP module. For 204.8T of switching capacity a traditional 1.6T OSFP solution needs 4U of rack space versus 1U for the 12.8T XPO solution (front-panel bandwidth density up to four times higher), aimed at high-density AI cluster scale-out and scale-up networks. LRO cuts power consumption by 30% versus a Full DSP solution; a built-in integrated cold plate removes heat from the DSP and optical engine, and quick-disconnect liquid-cooling interfaces allow on-site front-panel module replacement. The XPO platform supports LPO, LRO, FRO and other interface architectures and DR, FR, LR, ZR/ZR+ optical interface standards. Shown as an exhibit; no availability date, customers or volumes stated.
quarterly_data.figure: 12.8T per module (64x200G PAM4, 2.7 times OSFP width); 204.8T switching in 1U vs 4U; 30% lower power vs Full DSP
